# prepend-http [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/prepend-http.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/prepend-http)

> Prepend `http://` to humanized URLs like `example.invalid` and `localhost`


## Install

```
$ npm install --save prepend-http
```


## Usage

```js
const prependHttp = require('prepend-http');

prependHttp('example.invalid');
//=> 'http://example.invalid'

prependHttp('localhost');
//=> 'http://localhost'

prependHttp('http://example.invalid');
//=> 'http://example.invalid'
```
